subject: Confirmation: Flight Booking for Your Upcoming Trip
body: Dear [Recipient], We are pleased to inform you that your flight booking for your upcoming trip has been successfully confirmed. Your itinerary includes a direct flight from New York to Paris on August 15th, departing at 9:00 AM. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure for check-in. We wish you a pleasant journey and look forward to serving you onboard. Safe travels, The Travel Agency Team
